Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card itself is played?

Card Q&A.a:
5000 DP or less. If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed isn't being made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect is processed will be referenced. In this case, processing was performed when your BT6-083 [Eosmon] had 5000 DP, therefore you can delete a Digimon with 5000 DP or less.

Card Q&A.q: My BT6-083 [Eosmon] was played, then this card's [All Turns] effect and another effect triggered simultaneously. If another effect activates and the DP of my played BT6-083 [Eosmon] changes from 4000 to 5000, then I activate this card's [All Turns] effect, what is the DP of Digimon I can delete?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed isn't being made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect is processed will be referenced. In this case, because the Digimon that could be referenced by this card's [All Turns] effect was removed, you can't delete a Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Another of my [Eosmon] was played, then this card's [All Turns] effect and another effect triggered simultaneously. I activated the other effect, then my played [Eosmon] was removed from the battle area. If I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect, can I delete an opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 level 5 or lower [Eosmon] from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your [Eosmon] is played, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as that Digimon.
[Your Turn] For each Tamer, all of your [Eosmon] get +1000 DP.
